summary: Waldur 8.1.3-rc.16 adds a staff offering merge tool and a context-aware changelog system. Staff can use the merge tool to combine duplicate marketplace offerings. It includes a preview of affected rows, background execution, post-merge verification and undo, and it is also used to clean up duplicate per-tenant OpenStack offerings. The changelog system lets each deployment show staff what an upgrade brings. Other backend changes: orders allocated through proposal calls are now attributed to a real person, role definition changes are audited, outbound SCIM entitlements are now enabled per offering, and only staff and support can create support requests on behalf of other users. This release also fixes the resource restore state, no-op price logs, offering import and export, VMware datastore sizes, service desk seeding and email diagnostics. In the UI, applicant eligibility can now be configured from the call page and the orders list gets a Limits column. The release also includes many accessibility, dark mode, layering and order form fixes, a consistent alert and toast notification system, and an operator-editable language list for Docker Compose deployments.

entries.title: Accessibility and keyboard navigation fixes
entries.description: Fixed WCAG 2.2 AA findings from an axe-core scan across tables, sidebar, tabs and forms. Pressing Enter on a link without an onClick handler, or on a read-only avatar strip, no longer throws an error. The My Access Requests view switch is now a keyboard-operable radio group, and the sign-in method switch uses accessible tabs.

entries.title: AI assistant display fixes
entries.description: Mermaid diagrams in AI assistant replies now fit the chat bubble. The conversation marker now stays on the AI assistant button.

entries.title: Attribute call-allocated orders to a real person
entries.description: Previously, orders placed when a call allocated resources were not attributed to a real person. Now, these orders are attributed to a person and flagged as placed automatically. The call's support ticket caller option is renamed to order author.

actions.description: Marketplace migration 0297_order_placed_automatically adds an automatic-placement flag to orders. Proposal migration 0081 renames the support ticket caller option to order author.

entries.title: Audit changes to role definitions
entries.description: Previously, changes to role definitions were not audited. Now, they are logged as events and shown in the audit feed.

entries.title: Bump anyio and soupsieve dependencies
entries.description: Previously, the pinned versions of anyio and soupsieve were flagged by the OSV scan. Now, both are upgraded to clear those findings.

entries.title: Change limits shows correct usage and prepaid pricing
entries.description: The Change limits view showed incorrect usage values and priced prepaid limit changes over the wrong period. It now shows correct usage and prices prepaid limit changes over the resource's actual remaining months.

entries.title: Configure applicant eligibility from the call UI
entries.description: Previously, applicant eligibility restrictions could not be configured from the call UI. Now, the call page has an eligibility section for setting them.

entries.title: Consistent alerts, toast notifications and dialog button order
entries.description: Previously, alerts and toast notifications were built on Bootstrap components, and dialog buttons did not follow a consistent order. Now, toast notifications are rebuilt on the design system, alerts use the shared AlertItem component, and dialog buttons follow an enforced order.

entries.title: Context-aware changelog system
entries.description: Previously, deployments had no machine-readable way to show staff what an upgrade brings. Now, a new changelog app assembles structured release changelogs, serves them through an API, and exposes version metadata. Each change is shown only once across a release candidate cycle.

actions.description: Initial migration for the new waldur_core.changelog app.

entries.title: Dark mode and login layout theming fixes
entries.description: Dark mode styles now use the correct theme attribute on login layouts. Mermaid charts take their colours from design tokens and display correctly in dark mode. The provider ticket assignee picker is themed for dark mode, and login footer links are readable on gradient layouts.

entries.title: Email diagnostics handle display-name sender addresses
entries.description: Email diagnostics did not work correctly when the sender address included a display name. Such addresses are now handled.

entries.title: Limits column in the marketplace orders list
entries.description: Previously, the marketplace orders list did not show order limits. Now, it has a Limits column.

entries.title: Log when a notification drop silences a mail
entries.description: Previously, a mail suppressed by a notification drop was skipped with no log entry. Now, a log entry is written when this happens.

entries.title: Menus, popovers and drawers no longer overlap or get cut off
entries.description: Header popovers now appear above the fixed toolbar. Select menus stay clickable inside the modal drawer. Floating drawers stay under the header and their toggles keep working. Tall actions menus are capped to the window height and scroll instead of running off-screen.

entries.title: Offering import and export keep values intact and reject invalid input
entries.description: Offering import now normalises null values and rejects invalid input. Offering export now keeps empty units and zero amounts instead of dropping them.

entries.title: Only staff and support can create support requests on behalf of others
entries.description: Creating a support request on behalf of another user is now limited to staff and support users.

entries.title: Operator-editable language list in Docker Compose
entries.description: Previously, Docker Compose deployments could not change the language list. Now, config/waldur-mastermind/languages.yaml is mounted into the containers so operators can edit it.

entries.title: Order form fixes for offering switching, default limits and closed steps
entries.description: The order form now updates correctly when the offering is switched inside it. It keeps the offering's default limits when the form is reinitialised, and gives a single consistent reason for why its steps are closed.

entries.title: Outbound SCIM entitlements gated behind an offering option
entries.description: Previously, outbound SCIM entitlements were not controlled per offering. Now, they are sent only for offerings where the new integration option is enabled. The option can be set in the offering's user management settings.

actions.description: Enable the outbound SCIM entitlements option on each offering that should keep pushing SCIM entitlements.

entries.title: Project chat rooms: one actions menu and no switcher showing other projects' rooms
entries.description: Previously, the chat drawer had a room switcher that listed rooms from other projects, and project chat room actions were shown as separate controls. Now, the switcher is removed and the room actions are grouped in one menu.

entries.title: Refused restore returns the resource to the terminated state
entries.description: When a restore order was refused, the resource did not return to its previous state. It now goes back to the terminated state.

entries.title: Removing a project grant sends the correct project
entries.description: Removing a project grant from the organization team list did not send the actual project UUID. It now does.

entries.title: Resolve duplicate per-tenant OpenStack offerings with the merge engine
entries.description: Previously, duplicate per-tenant OpenStack offerings had to be handled without the offering merge engine. Now, they are resolved through the merge engine, both from the dedupe_tenant_offerings management command and from a duplicate offerings API with a resolve action in the staff UI.

actions.description: Deployments with duplicate per-tenant OpenStack offerings can review and resolve them with the dedupe_tenant_offerings management command or the staff duplicate offerings view.

entries.title: Route guard and navigation fixes
entries.description: Permission gates could run before the workspace was resolved; they now wait for it. When a route guard refuses access, the denied address is now kept. Clicking a parent tab now opens its first child page.

entries.title: Service desk defaults reconcile a mistyped status
entries.description: The init_service_desk_defaults command skipped seeding when a status had the wrong type. It now corrects the existing status instead.

entries.title: Show measured units for requested resource amounts
entries.description: Previously, requested resource amounts in order summaries, plan rows and call resource requests were shown without their measured units. Now, the units are shown.

entries.title: Staff offering merge tool with preview, background execution and undo
entries.description: Previously, there was no supported way to combine duplicate marketplace offerings. Now, a merge engine records each merge, previews the rows it will change grouped by area, runs the merge in the background, applies an invoice snapshot policy, checks the result after the merge, and supports undo. A staff API and a new UI provide a merge wizard, merge history, merge details, grouped preview tables with drill-down, and a dialog with verification details. Merge progress is reported through new events.

actions.description: Marketplace migrations 0294_offering_merge and 0295_offering_merge_progress add the offering merge record and progress tracking.

entries.title: Stop logging plan component price updates that changed nothing
entries.description: Plan component price updates were logged even when nothing changed, including during remote offering sync. These no-op updates are no longer logged, and a data migration removes the existing no-op price logs.

actions.description: Marketplace migration 0296_clean_noop_price_logs removes existing log entries for price updates that changed nothing.

entries.title: Store VMware datastore sizes in 64-bit columns
entries.description: VMware datastore capacity and free space were stored in columns too small for large datastores. They are now stored in 64-bit columns.

actions.description: VMware migration 0030 changes the datastore capacity and free_space columns to 64-bit integers.
